rec: Ardougne cloak 1 or higher for teleports to the monastery

st.t: Talk to Brother Omad in the monastery south of East Ardougne.
s: Why can't you sleep, what's wrong?

st.t: Go down the ladder in a circle of stones west of the monastery.
Pick up the Child's blanket in the room to the south.
Bring the blanket back to Brother Omad in the monastery.

s: Is there anything else I can help with?

st.t: Talk to Brother Cedric north of the monastery, directly south of Ardougne Zoo, near the well.
Talk to Brother Cedric once again with logs.
Return to Brother Omad to finish the quest.
